# scc_device_tenant_policy (Data Source)

Look up an existing DeviceTenantPolicy object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) Maps to the -Comment parameter.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -Enabled parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `retry_distribution` (Boolean) Maps to the -RetryDistribution parameter.
